title: Algerian Tagine Stew
description: A delicious Algerian stew made with tender meat and flavorful spices, slow-cooked in a traditional earthenware pot.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the algerian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dried prunes, kissed dates, and fruit, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
